new_result.scope: exact-rank-three indefinite signature (2,1), scaled density height
new_result.statement: If C_- = sup s sup_{t<0} p_Q(t), W_- = sup_{y<=-1} (s/2) P(|Q-y|<=1), and K_- = sup_{y<=-1} s E(1-|Q-y|)_+, then C_-=W_-=K_-. Also C_- = sup s sup_{t<=-1}p_Q(t). With the completed one-sheet theorem, C_- <= C_{3,ind} <= max(pi sqrt(2),C_-).
new_result.key_mechanism: positive scalar multiplication A->aA preserves scaled density height and moves any minority point to distance >=1 from the critical value; fixed-instance C_0 continuity converts fixed unit windows/tents back to the pointwise density value
new_result.important_nonimplication: The X-ray-only correction survives: its counterexample already blows up near q=-1, so unit-gap normalization does not permit a projection-only proof.

unresolved_implication: Prove universal s P(|X^T A X-y|<=1)<=C for every exact-rank-three signature (2,1) target and every y<=-1 using original-product provenance beyond generic X-ray control; higher-rank N3/hybrid closure remains.
